headline: Foreign Investors Net Buy Taiwan Stocks NT$90.3 Billion, Third-Largest in History; Net Short Positions in TAIEX Futures at 87,000 Contracts | Securities
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at 44,611 after a 1,250-point gain. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors net bought NT$90.3 billion, the third-largest single-day net buying on record.
why: The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Stock Index (TAIEX) tracks the island's listed companies, many of which are major global suppliers of semiconductors and electronics. Large foreign flows show how international investors are positioned in Taiwan.
why_moved: Taiwan stocks rose 1,250 points, the 11th-largest point gain in historical closing terms, as foreign and mainland Chinese investors net bought NT$90.3 billion. Institutional groups combined net bought NT$100.4 billion.
